scope: P8 bounded and cancelable Electron performance trace capture.
implemented: Diagnostics exposes a desktop-only capture control with a visible 30-second countdown and cancellation.
Electron permits only one capture at a time, records for at most 30 seconds, writes only after a native save choice, and removes temporary files.
Common query credentials, authorization values and WebSocket paths are scrubbed before the selected JSON file is written.
remaining: Packaged-Windows acceptance must capture and cancel real traces, inspect usefulness and confirm secrets from representative runtime events are absent.
release: Source and automated fixtures only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
